title_sq: Tek "Lion Residences 2", Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Siperfaqe Te Bollshme Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Tek "Lion Residences 2", Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Siperfaqe Te Bollshme Dhe Planimetri Perfekte!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 10-te banim te nje kompleksi te ri ne faze ndertimi. Lion Residence 2 eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Apartamenti ka orientim Jug-Lindje cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: korridori, salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti.
title_en: At "Lion Residences 2", 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Area and Perfect Layout!!!
description_en: At "Lion Residences 2", 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Ample Area and Perfect Layout!!! The apartment is located on the 10th residential floor of a new complex under construction. Lion Residence 2 is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has a South-East orientation, which enables natural lighting during most of the day. The internal organization is as follows: corridor, living room connected to the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, bedroom and toilet.
